cases.decision_rationale: Persona steering can change cognitive benchmark performance as well as style, with task-dependent benefits and harms.
required_before_drafting: Methodology and experimental procedure; Leveraging Persona-Task Regularities including reference/test split, hit definition and mixed task outcomes. May v2; CogSci 2026 reference in arXiv metadata.
evidence_transition_preconditions: Separate accepted transition for any stronger architecture/local claim.
promotion_blockers: The intervention bundles a named trait with activation changes; it does not isolate a human psychological construct as the unique cause. Small held-out subsets, best-static comparisons and set-valued success limit routing conclusions. Cross-species directional agreement is not shared biological mechanism evidence.
non_claims: Contextual source integration only; no new local model behavior or support transition.

cases.decision_rationale: A steering coefficient is not a behavioral trait intensity; calibrated requests require a measured response curve.
required_before_drafting: Sections 3.1–3.3 and 6–7: controller, calibration/reachability, update effects and limitations. Selected held-out results and denominator distinctions.
evidence_transition_preconditions: Separate accepted transition for any stronger architecture/local claim.
promotion_blockers: Mean targets do not constrain each answer. Coherence is intelligibility, not factual correctness or safety. Reachable request sets differ between methods, so MAEs are not a paired common-request advantage. Some held-out coherence floors fail; stale-map error after controller update is not measured.
non_claims: Contextual source integration only; no new local model behavior or support transition.

cases.decision_rationale: Considers assistant behavior as a persona elicited from pretraining character representations and refined in post-training.
required_before_drafting: Opening model statement; representational evidence discussion; How exhaustive is PSM? and its alternative agency accounts. Authored conceptual research essay, not a new universal identification theorem.
evidence_transition_preconditions: Separate accepted transition for any stronger architecture/local claim.
promotion_blockers: Persona-like behavior and controllable trait expression do not settle the location or completeness of learned agency. The framework is not a causal proof that no hidden objective or non-persona mechanism exists.
non_claims: Contextual source integration only; no new local model behavior or support transition.
